ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && RecordType.Name = "Overage Milestone" && OR(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, "Reviewed by AE/SDM"), ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, "Final Approval SVP"), ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, "Ready for GP Invoice"), ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, "Invoice Sent to Client")) && OR(AE_Approved__c = false, SDM_Approved__c = false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you are removing AE or SDM approval you must set the status back to Reviewed by SVP or none.
